      PCT=$((SWAP_USED * 100 / SWAP_TOTAL))
      echo "  Used: $((SWAP_USED / 1024))MB / $((SWAP_TOTAL / 1024))MB ($PCT%)"
      if [ "$PCT" -gt 50 ]; then
        echo "  WARNING: Swap usage above 50%!"
      fi

          NAME=$(grep Name /proc/$pid/status 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
          echo "  $NAME (PID $pid): ${SWAP}kB swap"
